title: 晶粒對晶粒堆疊
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入堆疊拓撲、累積誤差與可測性。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore stack topology, accumulated error and testability, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 堆疊定義
stages.description: 針對堆疊定義完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for stack definition, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 面向與拓撲｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Orientation and topology | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對面向與拓撲，把「面對面與背對面堆疊改變 TSV 需求和可用電極。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For orientation and topology, turn "Face-to-face versus back-to-face changes TSV needs and accessible pads." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「面向與拓撲」的模型：面對面與背對面堆疊改變 TSV 需求和可用電極。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「畫每層訊號、電源和背面。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for orientation and topology: Face-to-face versus back-to-face changes TSV needs and accessible pads. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Draw signals, supplies and backsides for every layer. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 畫每層訊號、電源和背面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Draw signals, supplies and backsides for every layer. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：所有堆疊方向可共用同一接線圖。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Reusing one net map for every orientation. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付面向與拓撲的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for orientation and topology, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 面向與拓撲：機制
knowledge.text: 面對面與背對面堆疊改變 TSV 需求和可用電極。
knowledge.textEn: Face-to-face versus back-to-face changes TSV needs and accessible pads.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 畫每層訊號、電源和背面。 必須排除的錯判：所有堆疊方向可共用同一接線圖。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Draw signals, supplies and backsides for every layer. Misinterpretation to reject: Reusing one net map for every orientation. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「面向與拓撲」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For orientation and topology — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 面對面與背對面堆疊改變 TSV 需求和可用電極。
所有堆疊方向可共用同一接線圖
每層偏移小就不用量整體漂移
optionsEn: Face-to-face versus back-to-face changes TSV needs and accessible pads.
Reusing one net map for every orientation
Ignoring global drift when individual shifts are small
quiz.explanation: 面對面與背對面堆疊改變 TSV 需求和可用電極。 畫每層訊號、電源和背面。 因此不能採用「所有堆疊方向可共用同一接線圖」。
quiz.explanationEn: Face-to-face versus back-to-face changes TSV needs and accessible pads. Draw signals, supplies and backsides for every layer. Therefore reject: Reusing one net map for every orientation.

steps.title: 面向與拓撲｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Orientation and topology | evidence and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對面向與拓撲，把「面對面與背對面堆疊改變 TSV 需求和可用電極。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For orientation and topology, turn "Face-to-face versus back-to-face changes TSV needs and accessible pads." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：畫每層訊號、電源和背面。 將「所有堆疊方向可共用同一接線圖」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Draw signals, supplies and backsides for every layer. Challenge the hypothesis "Reusing one net map for every orientation" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 畫每層訊號、電源和背面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Draw signals, supplies and backsides for every layer. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：所有堆疊方向可共用同一接線圖。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Reusing one net map for every orientation. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付面向與拓撲的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for orientation and topology: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.title: 層間接口契約｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Interlayer interface contract | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對層間接口契約，把「尺寸、電壓、時序和熱負荷須同時相容。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For interlayer interface contract, turn "Dimensions, voltage, timing and thermal load must all be compatible." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「層間接口契約」的模型：尺寸、電壓、時序和熱負荷須同時相容。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「列上下層雙方簽認的接口表。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for interlayer interface contract: Dimensions, voltage, timing and thermal load must all be compatible. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Create an interface table agreed by both layers. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 列上下層雙方簽認的接口表。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Create an interface table agreed by both layers. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：幾何能接合即表示電路相容。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating mechanical mating with circuit compatibility. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付層間接口契約的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for interlayer interface contract, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

quiz.question: 在「層間接口契約」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For interlayer interface contract — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 幾何能接合即表示電路相容
最上層影像可代表所有埋藏界面
尺寸、電壓、時序和熱負荷須同時相容。
optionsEn: Equating mechanical mating with circuit compatibility
Using top-layer images for every buried interface
Dimensions, voltage, timing and thermal load must all be compatible.
quiz.explanation: 尺寸、電壓、時序和熱負荷須同時相容。 列上下層雙方簽認的接口表。 因此不能採用「幾何能接合即表示電路相容」。
quiz.explanationEn: Dimensions, voltage, timing and thermal load must all be compatible. Create an interface table agreed by both layers. Therefore reject: Equating mechanical mating with circuit compatibility.

steps.objectiveEn: For thickness accumulation, turn "Random and systematic thickness errors accumulate differently." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for thickness accumulation: Random and systematic thickness errors accumulate differently. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Separate tool bias from wafer-to-wafer variation. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.

quiz.questionEn: For thickness accumulation — evidence and diagnosis — which decision or action is justified?
options: 全部厚度公差都可平方和開根
所有層用電相同即各 TSV 同電流
區分同機台偏差與逐片變異。
optionsEn: Applying RSS to every thickness tolerance
Assuming equal layer power gives equal TSV currents
Separate tool bias from wafer-to-wafer variation.
quiz.explanation: 隨機與系統厚度誤差累積方式不同。 區分同機台偏差與逐片變異。 因此不能採用「全部厚度公差都可平方和開根」。
quiz.explanationEn: Random and systematic thickness errors accumulate differently. Separate tool bias from wafer-to-wafer variation. Therefore reject: Applying RSS to every thickness tolerance.
